top_choice_rationale: P004 gives the strongest bounded explanatory mechanism: simple stochastic growth physics predicts universal fluctuation statistics in specified regimes and meets quantitative experiment beyond a generic growth analogy. Kardar, Zhang and Takeuchi remain a provisional allocation, conditional on complete original authorship and experimentally controlled dimensionality, geometry, preparation and crossovers; the three-person rule cannot make an equally indispensable original theorist disappear. DMFT is my leading alternative for a dynamical organizing description, followed by the focused QSH phase-and-realization proposal. Clock shift control, circuit-QED interaction and original transmission correction are fundamental inventions with their own unresolved histories. IceCube's new messenger is profound but its exact pair still needs personally decisive discovery-analysis credit. I favor a substantive award over P000 rather than equate incomplete dossiers with absent scientific merit.
recusal_note: My supplied profile identifies no direct personal or institutional tie to Kardar, Zhang or Takeuchi. Work on stochastic and universal mechanisms creates intellectual proximity, not a candidate-conflict finding or automatic clearance. I disclose the linked Gothenburg environment shared with committee peers Johansson and Olsson and give their arguments no added weight. Any concrete candidate connection found in the historical review requires independent participation assessment.
